pending_reasons.VAL-EP001-IMG0285: Elder's silhouette drifted into modern fashion: knee-length flared coat with a fur stole collar and tan/yellow hair, reading as an Edwardian lady rather than a 48-year-old male flocksman in a felted wool cloak and ragged sheepskin. Must be rerendered with crude knee-length homespun, matte ash-white hair and a male shoulder line.
pending_reasons.VAL-EP001-IMG0286: Basalt columns returned as regularly hewn, mortarless blocks with false joints at right angles, reading as quarried masonry or a fortress rampart rather than natural hexagonal columns. Must be rerendered with irregular chipped uneven natural stone and no constructional coursing.
pending_reasons.VAL-EP001-IMG0290: Young herdsman grew heavy twin forehead braids falling in front of the shoulders, which are not in his lock (two thin narrow temple braids only). Reads as a fantasy lead rather than the locked Stage A youth. Must be rerendered with loose long hair and only two slim temple braids.
